constraints.name: attempts_repair_answer_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((repair_run_id IS NULL) OR COALESCE(((NOT (answer ? 'option_id'::text)) AND (((answer_redacted_at IS NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof((answer -> 'text'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (btrim((answer ->> 'text'::text)) <> ''::text) AND ((char_length((answer ->> 'text'::text)) >= 1) AND (char_length((answer ->> 'text'::text)) <= 400))) OR ((answer_redacted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (answer_redacted_at >= submitted_at) AND (NOT (answer ? 'text'::text))))), false)))

constraints.name: attempts_repair_metadata_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((repair_run_id IS NULL) AND (repair_case_role IS NULL) AND (verdict IS NULL) AND (judge_source IS NULL) AND (rule_version IS NULL) AND (prompt_version IS NULL) AND (model_id IS NULL) AND (fallback_reason IS NULL) AND (feedback_text IS NULL) AND (attempt_no IS NULL) AND (wrong_hypothesis_code IS NULL) AND (answer_redacted_at IS NULL)) OR ((repair_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (repair_case_role IS NOT NULL) AND (repair_case_role = ANY (ARRAY['onboarding'::text, 'festival'::text, 'finale'::text, 'remote'::text])) AND (verdict IS NOT NULL) AND (verdict = ANY (ARRAY['correct'::text, 'partial'::text, 'wrong'::text, 'needs'::text, 'unclear'::text])) AND (judge_source IS NOT NULL) AND (judge_source = ANY (ARRAY['rule'::text, 'model'::text, 'hybrid'::text])) AND (rule_version IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(rule_version) <> ''::text) AND (attempt_no IS NOT NULL) AND (attempt_no >= 1) AND (is_correct = (verdict = 'correct'::text)) AND ((scope)::text = 'activity'::text) AND (step_key IS NULL) AND ((judge_source = 'rule'::text) OR ((prompt_version IS NOT NULL) AND (model_id IS NOT NULL))))))

constraints.name: attempts_wrong_only_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((wrong_hypothesis_code IS NULL) OR ((verdict IS NOT NULL) AND (verdict = 'wrong'::text))))

constraints.name: learning_attempts_scope_step_consistent_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((scope)::text = 'step'::text) AND (step_key IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim((step_key)::text) <> ''::text)) OR (((scope)::text = 'activity'::text) AND (step_key IS NULL))))

constraints.name: repair_without_assignment
constraints.definition: CHECK (((repair_run_id IS NULL) OR (assignment_id IS NULL)))
